☀️ Your money this morning, Wednesday 11 November

🇺🇸 Overnight in New York: US inflation came in hotter than expected (prices rose 0.4% in October), raising fears of higher US interest rates. The S&P 500 fell 0.4% and the Nasdaq 0.7%, with tech leading the drop.

💱 The rand ended Tuesday about 1% weaker at R16.54 to the dollar; gold fell 2.7%; Brent oil is up 1% this morning at about $92.

What it means for you: higher US rates can strengthen the dollar, which tends to weaken the rand and push up fuel and import costs.

Prices are 15-minute delayed. Education, not financial advice.
